title: cuscuta scabrella
intro: Cuscuta scabrella, commonly known as Dodder, is a parasitic plant that derives its nutrients by connecting to the vascular tissues of its host plant. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to improve fertility, reduce inflammation, and alleviate stress. The therapeutic actions of Cuscuta scabrella are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which work to balance the body's physiological processes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
